subject: Observability onboarding & runbook kickoff — ClearHealth
messages:
From: Clara Wu <clara.wu@clearhealth.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability onboarding & runbook kickoff — ClearHealth

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We're ready to start the observability onboarding for our inference stack. High-level asks:

- Get a customer-facing dashboard with request latency P50/P95, token throughput, and error rates per model variant.
- Add tracing hooks to our service so we can correlate request IDs back to test traces.
- Agree an error taxonomy (inference-error, model-fallback, infra-timeout) and map alert routes.
- A runbook for on-call steps and who to page for model degradations vs infra issues.

I've attached our initial requirements workbook and a short prework CSV that lists our current alerting endpoints. Miguel is our engineering lead and will help with access.

Could you propose a short kickoff agenda and an owner list? Also please note our compliance team will want visibility into log retention settings.

Files attached: ClearHealth-observability-requirements.xlsx (xls), obs-onboarding-prework.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Clara
Product Ops | ClearHealth Analytics
clara.wu@clearhealth.ai

---
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>
To: Clara Wu <clara.wu@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding & runbook kickoff — ClearHealth

Hi Clara — great to kick this off. Proposed 60-minute agenda:

1) Introductions & owners (10m) — me (onboarding), Marissa (CS ops), Ben (SRE/telemetry)
2) Requirements review (10m) — walk the attached workbook
3) Dashboards & traces (20m) — sample panels, trace IDs, and Grafana access
4) Alerts & taxonomy (10m) — proposed mapping and routing tiers
5) Runbook + next steps & timeline (10m)

Can your infra lead (Miguel) confirm the Grafana and tracing endpoints ahead of the call? We also need an initial list of service request ID patterns for prefix-based KV caching traces. If you can grant Marissa read access to your Grafana team dashboard (or send a snapshot link) that would speed the prep.

I'll book a slot for next week after hearing your availability. Also copying Ben so we can sketch the SLOs he'll instrument.

Action items for the kickoff:
- Clara: confirm availability + Grafana link (if possible)
- Miguel: share tracer header format and sampling rate
- Marissa: prepare runbook template and copy of our on-call escalation matrix

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com

From: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@clearhealth.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Clara Wu <clara.wu@clearhealth.ai>, Security Team <security@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 07:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding & runbook kickoff — ClearHealth

Avery / team,

Thanks — confirming availability for Wed 2027-04-14 10:30-11:30 PT. Quick answers to prep items:

- Grafana: https://grafana.clearhealth.ai/d/abcd1234/customer-dashboards (read-only token can be minted; Clara will send)
- Tracing: we use open-telemetry with header 'x-req-id' + 'traceparent'; sampling currently at 1% for production, can bump to 5% for the onboarding window.
- Request ID pattern: CH-<service>-<env>-<uuid> (e.g., CH-ingest-prod-7f8c)
- Retention: logs stored 90 days; security will ask for retention policy doc — attaching SOW draft and I loop in them below.

Forwarded message follows:

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Security Team <security@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 07:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding — retention
To: miguel.torres@clearhealth.ai

Hi Miguel,
Please confirm if Redwood's platform supports configurable retention to 180 days and whether audit logs can be exported to our S3. We'll need an outline for the compliance review.

Regards,
ClearHealth Security

Looking forward to the kickoff.
Miguel

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding & runbook kickoff — ClearHealth

Avery / team — quick internal note before the Wed kickoff:

Summary of actions I'm taking on the call and after:
- I'll draft an SLO shortlist (latency P50/P95, error-rate by model variant, request success rate) and a proposed alert priority matrix.
- I'll prepare a runbook skeleton (steps: detect, validate, isolate, mitigate, postmortem) and share it to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RunbookTemplate
- Ben: please have a short slide on where we'll place tracer hooks (service ingress vs model sidecar) and the expected sampling impact.
- Marissa: bring a copy of the CS handoff checklist and the SDK onboarding doc for tokenized traces.

I'll also coordinate with Security to capture retention options (90/180/365 days) and S3 export capabilities so we can answer compliance questions on the kickoff.

See you on Wed — inviting a 30m internal prep at 09:00 PT tomorrow (will send separate invite).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
